Perks › Uncommon

Boneyard Lantern

Uncommon perk · Information

Every time you go to the boneyard, one fixed face-down bone is revealed.

In-game card text

How it works

Every time you go to the boneyard, one face-down bone in the boneyard is turned face-up for you before you choose. You still pick which bone to take, so you can take the revealed one or avoid it.

  • The revealed bone is the next bone in the boneyard's fixed order, so it is shown again on later visits until someone takes it.
  • Extra copies do not reveal more bones.
  • This is a passive perk. It is a different thing from the Boneyard Lantern supply, which lights up one random bone for a single trip.
